introPt: A regional joke lands at a table and a visitor stays out of it gracefully.
cenario: Regional rivalry comes up in conversation.

dialogo.es: Ay, ya llegó el chilango a decirnos cómo se hace.
dialogo.pt: Here comes the chilango to tell us how it is done.
What part of Mexico are you from?

dialogo.es: De Monterrey. Regio de toda la vida.
dialogo.pt: From Monterrey. Regio my whole life.

dialogo.es: Uy, en esa no me meto.
dialogo.pt: Oh, I'm staying out of that one.

perguntas.explica: Worn proudly inside the capital, often an edge outside it.

perguntas.pergunta: Why does the term carry a sting outside the capital?
opcoes: It implies arrogance and detachment from the rest of the country
It refers to a political party
perguntas.explica: It sits on a real grievance about centralisation.

perguntas.pergunta: What is the reliable neutral question?
perguntas.explica: It lets the person name themselves, and you use their word.

perguntas.pergunta: Someone invites you to agree that a region is the problem. What works?
perguntas.explica: En esa no me meto is honest and well received.

perguntas.pergunta: Which label is also used dismissively?
perguntas.explica: It implies unsophistication; the insult runs both ways.
